rawContent: Check out our Co-Founder @winniemli speaking on @channel5_tv yesterday! #endvawg #MeToo

We're excited for the first of our @RSLiterature #LiteratureMatters events -- ONE WEEK AWAY at @wowfest in Liverpool. Don't miss them! Only £2 for the writing workshops and £4/2 to attend the public panel. #MeToo #endVAWG #StrongerTogether @newsfromnowhere
3 days until Clear Lines goes to #Liverpool! Have you got your tickets yet for our @wowfest collaboration on Monday? #endvawg #metoo https://t.co/IUuo9LtT23

We'll be at this exciting FREE event on Fri night in London to help launch ILA, a new social enterprise addressing gender inequality! Come hear our Founder @winniemli poet @TKtheTwit & lots of other great speakers on #MeToo #endVAWG. Free drinks! https://t.co/Uv0D8Dlz1c

£5 tickets to the innovative play #AnneMeetsJeffrey June 4-5 at @battersea_arts - A survivor of stranger rape meets her perpetrator 7 yrs later. We showcased an early version of it at our 2017 festival! #MeToo #endVAWG Use promo code 'EMMA5' to book https://t.co/MUXKzr3t66

We're thrilled to see this innovative play by @EmmaBerentsen come so far, since we showcased an early version at our 2017 festival! Don't miss it TONIGHT ONLY at @battersea_arts & you can get £5 tix when you book with the code EMMA5. #MeToo #StrongerTogether #endVAWG

A few more tickets have just been released for the FREE ILAx launch event tomorrow, which is close to selling out! Reserve your space to hear some great speakers including our Founder @winniemli - and come say hi at our Clear Lines table! #MeToo #endVAWG https://t.co/Uv0D8Dlz1c
Introducing #ILAx to our work and mission at Clear Lines Festival #EndGBV #MeToo https://t.co/FFVvaYzhIu

'If we work as a collective voice, we can eradicate the narrative of shame'. Our Co-Founder @winniemli talking about the incredible community of survivors and activists out there who have such potential to drive change in so many sectors of society #MeToo
Our long time friend and collaborator @TKtheTwit ending #ILAx with his raw, emotive and honest #spokenword #MeToo https://t.co/v9KBjYR3xT

In the 1980s, @SohailaAbdulali was the first Indian rape survivor to speak out in the media about her experience. On July 8th hear her reflect on the choices she has made in order to prompt a more productive public conversation about sexual assault #metoo https://t.co/cLYHYzOTwA

Does rape always have to be a life-defining event? Come to our next event to hear bestselling authors @SohailaAbdulali and @winniemli explore important questions around sexual assault as writers and survivors @WaterstonesTCR #metoo #endvawg https://t.co/cLYHYzOTwA

Preparations are well under way & tickets are selling fast for #whatwetalkaboutwhenwetalkaboutrape with @winniemli & @SohailaAbdulali sharing their insights on the public conversation on rape.  Don't leave it too late to get your ticket. #metoo #evaw https://t.co/cLYHYzOTwA

What are the next steps after #MeToo ? Here's another great interview with @SohailaAbdulali + @TinaTchen + @nytimes journalist @emilysteel - We'll be hosting a conversation with Sohaila at our July 8th event at @WaterstonesTCR #endVAWG Don't miss it!  https://t.co/4spi7b8dQC
We are proud to be hosting Sohaila’s only public London event on her UK book tour next week! Next Monday, July 8. #MeToo #endVAWG Tickets: https://t.co/cLYHYzOTwA
Thank you for sharing this @NatalieNicole , we are looking forward to hearing @winniemli talk about this and more at our event on 8th July.  #metoo #EVAW  https://t.co/CtQYktxaE2
Yes, we're really looking forward to bringing @winniemli and @SohailaAbdulali together to discuss this.  #MeToo #whatwetalkaboutwhenwetalkaboutrape #darkchapter

'All the victims who hear the past icily whispering in their ears when rape comes to the forefront in the media deserve compassion.' @SohailaAbdulali in her groundbreaking book. Join our talk with her next Monday 6:30pm @WaterstonesTCR ! Tix £7 #MeToo  https://t.co/CtQYktxaE2

This is TONIGHT! There's still a few tickets left to hear the remarkable activist & international bestseller @SohailaAbdulali in conversation with our Co-Founder @winniemli - so don't miss out. It'll also be our last event of the summer! Tix £7 #MeToo https://t.co/gQUNX6qq3R https://t.co/ZSgru7iNEL

A HUGE thank you to @SohailaAbdulali @winniemli for such a memorable event last night. An honest & insightful conversation about rape, which meant a great deal to many in our sold-out audience. And to @KatrinaKilkenny @MyriadEditions ! #CL_Sohaila #MeToo https://t.co/pPtrjEirR7

Fancy getting involved with Clear Lines? We're on the lookout for new volunteers and a leadership committee to help pave the way! Come along to our next team meeting on Tuesday 23rd July, 7pm at @southbankcentre. Email us at clearlinesfestival@gmail.com for more info! #metoo https://t.co/IlaTpILO2j

REMINDER: our #clearlines team meeting will be TOMORROW eve, 7pm at @southbankcentre. Anyone interested in getting involved is welcome to come along! We'll be on the Blue Side, Level 3/4. Drop us a DM for more info #metoo https://t.co/62VMd3bMfh
Delighted to hear of Evelyn's overturned conviction in El Salvador #justiciaparaevelyn #endvawg #metoo https://t.co/L4J3nHistX

Research revealed that last year one in four female comics said they had been sexually assaulted while gigging, with one in 13 saying they’d been raped. Edinburgh fringe 'must do more' to tackle sexual harassment! #metoo https://t.co/PWRxbI9On4
Listen in to this week's episode of 'After' to hear our Co-Founder @winniemli joining @tacriona in conversation! #podcast #MeToo

Are you interested in using writing to share experiences of sexual and domestic abuse? Join us and our co-founder @winniemli for a free workshop with @Angles_project on the 19th of this month. Contact @onroadmedia to get your spot. Places are limited!  #WritingCommunity #MeToo
We're kicking off our #SetYourselfonFire screening with an amazing turnout. Really looking forward to our discussion with @UKSAYSNOMORE and @SheWillSurvive_ later on. #metoo #16days
.@writer_heathen everyone in the room currently captivated by your film #SetYourselfonFire. Doing so much to change the narrative around #sexualviolence #MeToo

Thanks to all who came along to lastnight's screening of #SetYourselfOnFire by @writer_heathen. Inspiring doc, fantastic speakers @UKSAYSNOMORE & @SheWillSurvive_ , and wonderful audience sharing reflections around the role of film in tackling #sexualviolence #metoo https://t.co/9DBatf77wt

Could we be any prouder of our Co-Founder @winniemli & Clear Lines friends @HazyDepths @kkat1511 for sharing their stories in this important feature out in @CosmopolitanUK NOW? Well done! And to @Angles_project @onroadmedia for their help behind the scenes. #MeToo #endVAWG
